items.title: France braces for another day of sweltering heat as Europe heatwave spreads
items.description: The heatwave is expected to spread to other parts of western Europe on Wednesday, before extending eastwards over the weekend.

items.title: Congress passes war powers measure for first time, breaking with Trump over Iran
items.description: The resolution passed on Tuesday was largely symbolic, but it adds to pressure on the White House to end the conflict once and for all.

items.title: UN says it will evacuate sailors stranded in Strait of Hormuz, as Rubio warns against tolls
items.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned Iran that no country can charge fees for ships to travel through the strait.

items.title: Clean sweep for Mamdani-backed candidates in New York's Democratic primary
items.description: Brad Lander unseats Dan Goldman in a race that laid bare the city's divisions over the Israel-Gaza war.

items.title: Ukraine strikes knock out power in key city in Russian-occupied Crimea
items.description: Sevastopol's Moscow-installed governor warns there will be no electricity in some areas until the evening.

items.title: France confirms first Ebola case
items.description: More than 260 people in the Democratic Republic of Congo are known to have died during the current outbreak.

items.title: French woman allegedly held captive by husband for 12 years rescued in Pakistan
items.description: Yasmina alleges she was held along with her five children, and they were all cut off from the outside world.

items.title: Sydney woman wakes from induced coma more than a week after shark attack
items.description: Leah Stewart, 34, had one of her arms amputated after she was bitten while swimming at Coogee Beach.

items.title: Eight sentenced to 450 years in prison over anti-ICE riot where officer was shot
items.description: An officer was shot in the neck during the Texas disorder by "Antifa Cell operatives", prosecutors said.

items.title: Bondi Beach shooting hero pleads not guilty to alleged assault on his father
items.description: Ahmed al Ahmed tackled one of the gunmen who killed 15 people at a Jewish event in December.

items.title: Kenya to charge students with murder over deadly school fire
items.description: Sixteen pupils, aged between 15 and 18, died when a fire broke out in a dormitory at Utumishi Girls' School last month.

items.title: Dozens of ships head through Strait of Hormuz after US-Iran deal
items.description: Traffic in the waterway has risen since the US and Iran signed a deal aimed at ending the war, including 42 ships on Saturday alone.
